name: custom-themes
description: The custom themes of this setup on one card: /themes picks Christmas Night (snowy trees with lights, a snow ground that follows the context window) Pixel Blue (a pixel night sky with Orion, more stars as the context fills), or Pokémon Pixel (a sunny pixel route with a battle box: the context is the HP bar). Apply for all projects or this session, preview for 20 seconds, or no theme. Two terminal themes for /theme.
